Gehlot Accuses Rajasthan Govt Over Water, Wages

Former Rajasthan Chief Minister Ashok Gehlot has accused the current Bhajan Lal government of failing to provide drinking water and withholding wages for the poor. Gehlot stated that stopping the wages of the poor is unbecoming of any government. He presented these accusations as a challenge to the current administration.
